subsystem.name: StandingsAndScoring
subsystem.responsibility: Session scoring and standings presentation layer: constructor-championship evaluation (clinch detection, podium parse, season GDB selection), scene-name-keyed scans of the mutable standings/scene-element list at dword_7D2DB0 (status validation, session-state search, position change detection, summed-field and entity-count helpers), driver-table display-entry emission anchored at flt_5EA618, the session scoring gate/reset controls, a sorted game-dictionary loader, and the dynamic-management restart handler. All class and field proposals are DERIVED or GUESS; packet owner evidence is UNKNOWN for most functions.

summary: Proposal for wave_003_generic_runtime_objects_06: five defensible class families across the standings/scoring/display layer. ConstructorChampionshipScoring (DERIVED) groups constructor-championship evaluation (0x0041F8A0 clinch detection, 0x00420820 podium parse, 0x00420CF0 season GDB selection) on shared 14-constructor name-table, ChampionshipPointsAccumulator and driver-table emission evidence. RaceStandings (DERIVED, anchored by the packet's own DERIVED owner for DualStatusValidator) groups scene-name-keyed list scans over dword_7D2DB0. GameDictionary (DERIVED) owns the sorted string-table loader 0x00423890 with two DERIVED fields at this+4 (entry_count) and this+8 (entries_ptr). SeasonScoringController (GUESS) and DynamicManager (GUESS) carry the scoring gate/reset and restart handler. Interfaces capture the standings-list accessor set, display-entry builder, scene-name resolution and string-buffer utilities. Trust stays at DERIVED/GUESS; no CONFIRMED claims. Contradictions and unresolved semantics (status value 10/6 meanings, offset 408/412/416 record layout, season indices, display ids, aRb/aSS globals, field:this:0x00000000) are recorded, not resolved.

function_roles.role: Constructor championship clinch predicate: resolves the input team against the 14-constructor name table, then verifies it leads all 13 rivals in cumulative points at every scoring-category prefix; returns 1 only when mathematically clinched.

Standings entrant validation: locates a named entrant by season-resolved scene name and requires both status values 10 and 6 at the rank-derived status offset; returns true only when both were observed.
Session-state search: scans the current-session list and then each active entity for a scene whose state table at byte offset 216 contains value 10; returns 1 when found.

Config-section search: walks the section table backwards looking for the first section whose type tag equals 10 and whose season/season name matches the target; returns the matching section index or 0.
Scene-element scan: finds an element whose season-resolved scene name matches and whose per-index dword field at offset 212 + 4*v2 equals 10; head element fast-path then active-element loop.

Session timing anomaly check: fetches two entrant records via BestLapEntrantFinder, derives a value from record fields and list flags/scene order, and returns a sentinel-initialized structure when the value lands in a small threshold window.

Standings position-change dispatch: locates the entries holding positions 1 and 2 by the offset-412 field, suppresses dispatch on ties via the offset-408 shared-value test, and emits driver-table message 397 when the dispatch flag is set.

Constructor standings podium parse: accumulates championship points for the 14 teams, selects the top three with tie detection, emits the podium team names, and builds driver-table display entries (ids 423/424/488) when enabled.

Season GDB selector: chooses the constructor with the most active drivers (tie-broken), probes the season path against four season GDB filenames, and fills/publishes a driver-table record for the selected season.
Summed-field helper: sums the dword field at entity offset 416 for every active entity whose season-resolved scene name matches the receiver.
Entity-state counter: counts active entities whose scene matches the receiver and whose state dword at offset 216 equals 10, via a nested active-entity/flag-array walk.

Game dictionary loader: builds the dictionary path, parses quoted key/value lines, inserts pairs into the sorted string table owned by this, sorts it, and reports a missing locale string; returns the inserted-pair count.

Session scoring gate: returns true only while global dword_7D2E44 is zero and SessionStateCheck on the session object at dword_7CD25C does not return 1; reused as a shared scoring predicate across 11 callers.
Season scoring reset: clears the global init flag, then loops the vehicle array setting team IDs and calling SessionStateTransition(-1, 0) per slot; returns the last transition result.

Dynamic-management restart: processes a build path, writes a debug entry, resets timer/session counters, reloads AI settings, forces per-vehicle render updates, runs a batch entity process, and resyncs the current player vehicle index and pointer.

classes.name: ConstructorChampionshipScoring
classes.responsibility: Evaluate constructor championship standings: detect a mathematically clinched constructor championship, parse the constructor podium from accumulated points with tie detection, and select the season GDB for the leading constructor; emits driver-table display entries when enabled.

classes.name: RaceStandings
classes.responsibility: Standings/scene-element list access over the mutable list at dword_7D2DB0: scene-name-keyed scans for entrant status validation, session-state search, config-section and scene-element lookup, position-change dispatch, summed-field accumulation and entity-state counting.

classes.name: GameDictionary
classes.responsibility: Sorted string-table dictionary loader: parse quoted key/value pairs from a dictionary file line by line, insert accepted pairs, sort the table, and verify presence of the locale string.

classes.name: SeasonScoringController
classes.responsibility: Gate and reset session scoring state: shared predicate that decides whether scoring may proceed, and the per-slot season scoring reset over the vehicle array.

classes.name: DynamicManager
classes.responsibility: Dynamic-management layer restart handler: reset session counters, reload AI settings, force render updates, run batch entity processing, and resync the current vehicle pointer.

state_machines.name: SessionScoringGate
transitions: OPEN->BLOCKED when dword_7D2E44 != 0 (short-circuits without consulting session state)

state_machines.name: ConstructorChampionshipClinch
transitions: NOT_CLINCHED->CLINCHED when the team leads all 13 rivals at a scoring-category prefix
CLINCHED impossible while any rival leads at any prefix (returns 0)

interfaces.name: IStandingsListAccess
interfaces.purpose: Dereference and index access to the mutable standings/scene-element list at dword_7D2DB0. Every consumer re-reads the global each use; the active-entity count is refreshed per loop iteration.

interfaces.name: IDisplayEntryBuilder
interfaces.purpose: Build and publish driver-table display entries: sentinel-initialize a record, resolve display indices from the format list dword_5EA5E8, fill it via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion, and insert it into the table anchored at flt_5EA618.

interfaces.name: ISceneNameResolution
interfaces.purpose: Fill an 80-byte season-resolved scene name for an entity (SceneNameLookupBySeason / SceneNamePointer) and test it against a target string; the exact equality/prefix semantics of the comparators are unresolved.

interfaces.name: IStringBuffer
interfaces.purpose: Reallocating string copy (StringCopyWithBufferRealloc), formatted string build (StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck), and allocator/free wrapper pair (OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper / FreeWrapper_7bcf) used across the constructor-name and cleanup paths.

compatibility_contracts.name: StandingsListContract
compatibility_contracts.description: dword_7D2DB0 is a mutable linked-list wrapper that every consumer re-dereferences on each use; the active-entity count and list pointer can change between iterations. A replacement must treat the list head as non-cacheable across scans and must keep the head/index accessor split (FixedOffsetReturn vs ShortComputation_13a0) observed here.

compatibility_contracts.name: DriverTableDisplayEntryContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Display entries are sentinel-initialized (StructInitWithSentinelValues with -1/-1/-2.0/-2.0 sentinels), resolved against the format list dword_5EA5E8, filled via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion with message ids 397/423/424/488 (and season ids 492/496/500/504), then published through InsertDriverTableEntry into the table anchored at flt_5EA618.

compatibility_contracts.name: ConstructorNameTableContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Fourteen constructor names (Arrows..Stewart) live in string globals 0x005C25B4..0x005C2620 and are selected by per-index jump tables (0x0041FAA0/0x0041FAD8, 0x00420C44/0x00420C7C/0x00420CB4, 0x00421200/0x00421238/0x00421270/0x004212A8). Index 0..13 is the team identity used by ChampionshipPointsAccumulator and by the season GDB selection.

compatibility_contracts.name: SeasonGdbSelectionContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Season GDB selection probes the season path global dword_7D0434 against four season filename literals (0x005BF970..0x005BF994) in order via sub_588410 and maps a hit to a driver-table season index (492/496/500/504); byte_5EA438 is the empty/fallback string across name lookups.

unresolved: Status values 10 and 6 at entrant status offsets 212/216 and the session-state-table meaning are not recoverable from this packet; the counted value 10 is an enum-like literal with unknown semantics.

RaceStandings membership of 0x004203F0 (SessionTimingAnomalyDetect) is GUESS; its entrant-record layout (threshold at element index 102, base at byte offset 408) and the result formula v5 + 10 * (sceneOrder - flags) are unresolved.

The offset-408 shared-value discriminator (tie detection) and offset-412 position field in PositionChangeDetector are DERIVED from comparison logic only; the standings entry structure is not identified.
The 8-byte working object (obj[0]=0, obj[1]=-1) allocated by GdbSeasonSelector and the season indices 492/496/500/504 and display ids 397/423/424/488 are passed verbatim without derived semantics.
callee:0x00587BCF (FreeWrapper_7bcf) is listed as a callee by static facts but does not appear in the raw decompiled bodies of 0x0041F8A0 and 0x00420820; its cleanup role is inferred, not verified.
Globals aRb (0x005BE828) and aSS (0x005BE860) are not named in the raw decompilation; they are likely file-open mode and path format constants consumed inside the callee chain.
dword_7D2DB0 is described as standings list, scene-element list and config-section list across functions; whether these are one shared mutable list or several distinct lists is unresolved.
field:this:0x00000000 (referenced by GdbSeasonSelector with LinkedListIndexScannerWithValidation) has no named meaning and is not assigned to a class field.
The fixed count 16 passed to the table sort (sub_5890AA) and the byte_5EA438 seed semantics in LoadGameDictionaryFile are unresolved.
ABI module classification Memory_Allocation (LEGACY) for 0x0041FB10 does not match the standings-oriented behavior and is treated as an unverified label.
sub_4C2990's contract (count vs rank-derived index) and the exact comparison semantics of sub_566810 and sub_588410 are not proven by this packet.
